title: Root Policy Script Refactor To Vocabulary Discovery Library
description:
This is step M4 of the "mechanism wave" (W4) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Mechanism changes" Step 4.

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL, especially the M1 completion note (search "M1 DONE"), which lists TWO findings **directly relevant to you**: (a) root `📜️script.ts`'s `policyDiscoverPluginCrateDirs` still requires a Shape V1 owner-root `📦️lib.rs` to match a plugin, so under Shape V2 (now ALL plugins) it only matches 🏗️fem — all 4 root taxonomy policy rules are effectively dark until this ticket lands; (b) `policyTaxonomyBarrelShapeBreaches` compares against an invalid area-enum value `"taxonomy"` — the correct value is `"clean"` — but that specific lint lives in a DIFFERENT, unrelated concurrent ticket's territory (`UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE`), so just flag it in your close-out summary rather than touching that file if it's outside root `📜️script.ts`'s taxonomy-specific region (check first).
3. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — M1's new shared vocabulary + discovery library, read in full. This is your new single source of truth.
4. Root `📜️script.ts` (repo root) — the CURRENT root policy script you are refactoring, read the FULL taxonomy-related region (search for `policyDiscoverPluginCrateDirs`, `POLICY_PLUGINS_ROOT`, `TaxonomyDirs`, `ComponentFile`, `CommandCoverage`, `DefinitionExports`, `NoUiGodfile`, `LabelsSingleton`, `SprNaming`, `TaxonomyLibShape`, and any other taxonomy-prefixed rule names).

YOUR TASK:
- Replace `policyDiscoverPluginCrateDirs`'s Shape-V1-only discovery with M1's `discoverPackages()`/vocabulary-driven discovery — this must correctly find ALL currently-migrated plugins (all 32 + demonstrator, Shape V2, `📦️lib.rs` inside `📦️packages/<lang>/`), not just fem.
- Drop the hardcoded `POLICY_PLUGINS_ROOT` scoping — per the plan, this is the FIRST time framework/hub become visible to root policy rules. Since this is a big surface-area change (framework/hub have never been checked by these rules before), land the NEW rules at WARN level for framework/hub initially (not error) — plugins can stay at whatever level they're already at since they've been checked all along. Do not silently promote framework/hub rules straight to error; that could produce a flood of pre-existing findings that aren't your job to fix.
- Wire up the existing taxonomy-related rule set (TaxonomyDirs/ComponentFile/CommandCoverage/DefinitionExports/NoUiGodfile/LabelsSingleton/SprNaming/TaxonomyLibShape) to run against the NOW-correctly-discovered plugin set.
- Note the `policyTaxonomyBarrelShapeBreaches` bug for the record in your close-out summary (do not fix it if it's owned by the concurrent UI-ELEMENT ticket — check whether it's in root `📜️script.ts`'s taxonomy region specifically, since if it IS in your scope of edit, the fix is a one-line value change `"taxonomy"` → `"clean"` and you should just make it while you're in the file, but call it out clearly as an aside, not the main point of this ticket).

VERIFICATION: run `bun ./📜️script.ts verify gate` (or whatever the equivalent policy-check command is — find it from the script's own CLI router) before and after your change. Since this is the FIRST time framework/hub are visible, expect NEW findings to surface that weren't checked before — that's expected and fine (log them, don't silently swallow them), but you must NOT introduce false positives against the plugin set that was already passing (compare the plugin-specific finding count/content before vs after — it should be identical, since plugins were already being validated correctly under the old Shape-V1-biased code by coincidence... actually check this carefully, since the doc says root policy rules were "effectively dark" for all 32 migrated plugins — meaning BEFORE your fix, these rules were silently finding NOTHING for any Shape V2 plugin. So after your fix, expect plugins to surface real findings for the first time too. Read each finding carefully and use judgment: if a finding reveals a REAL taxonomy violation in an already-migrated, already-closed plugin, log it clearly in your close-out summary as a discovered issue for a future forward-fix agent — do NOT attempt to fix 32 other plugins' taxonomy yourself, that's out of scope for this ticket.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, package.json workspaces, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, or any plugin directory.
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary (including any NEW findings surfaced by making the rules actually see framework/hub/all-32-plugins for the first time) and file list. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of what changed and any new findings surfaced (these matter a lot — they're the whole point of this fix).
summary:
M4 (mechanism wave W4, spicy-umbrella plan step 4) — root `📜️script.ts`'s policy region now discovers crates through M1's shared vocabulary/discovery library instead of a Shape-V1-only, plugins-only file scan. The 4 root taxonomy rules had been matching effectively nothing (only 🏗️fem) since all 32 plugins moved to Shape V2; they now see every migrated owner repo-wide for the first time.

WHAT CHANGED (root `📜️script.ts` only — no other file touched):
1. `policyDiscoverPluginCrateDirs` → `policyDiscoverCrateDirs`, driven by `discoverPackages()`/`discoverOwners()` over `🔣️taxonomy.json`. PRIMARY: every `📦️packages/🦀️rust[/🎯️targets/<t>]/Cargo.toml` with a semio role marker (45 rust packages: 32 plugins + 3 sourcing extensions + 2 trinity tools + 3 s-modules + 4 framework + 1 hub). SECONDARY burn-down: residual `⚡️implementations/🦀️rust` sandwiches *inside* an already-discovered owner (an owner that never adopted `📦️packages` is pre-contract and stays out of scope) — this arm is what W10's finalization flip deletes.
2. Crate-root entry file is now read from the manifest's own `[lib]`/`[[bin]] path` instead of being assumed, because the two shapes disagree (V2 `📦️lib.rs` beside the manifest vs. V1 `../../📦️lib.rs` at the owner root). Verified: all 45 discovered rust packages resolve to a file that exists, 0 misses, incl. fem's V1 leftover and trinity-shell's `📦️bin.rs`.
3. `POLICY_PLUGINS_ROOT` literal deleted. `policyScopeKey(repoRoot, path)` now resolves the owning plugin by longest-prefix match against discovered `role = "plugin"` owners (nested `role = "tool"` owners deliberately excluded so trinity's jack shell/lsp keep resolving to `trinity` — allowlist keys unchanged).
4. `PolicyCrateRef` carries `role`/`ownerRel`/`pluginId`; the Wave-4 app-plugin rules (region format, manifest region, struct naming, mod layout, selection ids, testkit delegate, tree item, labels) are now gated on `role === "plugin"` — semantic scoping by declared role, not by path prefix. The structural taxonomy rules run over every Shape V2 rust package regardless of role.
5. New `policyNewSurfacePriority()` — findings on framework/hub/s-module surface (never checked before M4) land at `"low"` (tracked), never error; plugin findings keep their existing priority. Applied to taxonomy/dirs, taxonomy/component-file, taxonomy/lib-shape, app-coupling, stray-cargo-artifact.
6. Vocabulary de-duplication: `POLICY_ARTIFACT_COMPONENT_DIRS`, `POLICY_WINDOW_CHILD_DIRS`, `POLICY_TAXONOMY_LEAF_PARENT_DIRS`, `POLICY_TAXONOMY_LIB_SHAPE_LINE_BUDGET` and the `⚡️implementations`/`📦️lib.rs`/`🗿️artifacts`/`🎛️apps`/`🪟️windows`/`🦀️component.rs` literals all deleted in favour of `loadTaxonomy()` (`artifactChildDirs`, `windowChildDirs`, `taxonomyLeafParentDirs`, `libWiringLineBudget`, `forbiddenPathSegments`, `entryFilenames`, `taxonomyLeafFilenames`, `artifactsDirName`, `appsDirName`, `windowsDirName`). Root script and registry can no longer drift apart.
7. `policyReaddirSafe` now applies `POLICY_SKIP_DIRS` — required, since `policySprNamingBreaches` recursively walks whole owner roots and would otherwise descend into `target/`/`node_modules/` for all 32 plugins.
8. `policySprNamingBreaches` scoped to `role === "plugin"`: the `📡️protocol` → `📡️spr` rename is a plugin-tree contract today; the framework's own protocol kernel module is renamed by the scheduled W8c os-kernel merge, so flagging it would report a rename that is planned, not late.
9. `policyCargoArtifactBreaches`: dropped the on-disk `target/` half of the rule (repo-wide `.gitignore target/` makes it a local build product that can never be "checked into" anything — with real discovery it would have fired on every dev's own `cargo build`). The `Cargo.lock` half is kept and now fires on real, git-TRACKED nested lockfiles.
10. ASIDE (the M1 finding #4 bug, in my region so fixed in place): `policyTaxonomyBarrelShapeBreaches` compared `pkg.area !== "taxonomy"` — a value that is not in `taxonomy.areaStates` at all, so the rule was structurally unable to ever match. Changed to the correct graduated state `"clean"` (extracted as `POLICY_BARREL_GRADUATED_AREA_STATE` with a comment). Still vacuous today because no area has graduated yet — that flip remains the W6 activation step of `26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE`; only the never-matchable literal is fixed, the rule's ownership is untouched.

VERIFICATION: `bun ./📜️script.ts policy` (the CLI's policy-check verb, wired to the `breach-script_ts` nx lint target) run before and after. Before: 602 breaches, of which the entire taxonomy rule set contributed 2 (fem only). After: 627, taxonomy + newly-visible rules contributing 27. Exit code unchanged (1, from 291 pre-existing high breaches — protocol-migration/pack/dsl/budget; my change adds 2 high, see below). NO REGRESSION on the already-checked plugin set: the per-crate app-plugin rule counts are byte-identical across the change (region-marker-format 290, region-tests-label, manifest-region 1, struct-naming 1, sdk-testkit-delegate 2, spr-naming 2) — the 31 newly-fed plugin `📦️lib.rs` entry files produced zero new breaches of those kinds. Counts drifted slightly between runs purely from concurrent sessions deleting legacy dirs mid-verification (S-MODULES ticket removed `✏️s/🔨️modules/📜️imperative/⚡️implementations` and 3 legacy plugin crates between two runs) — confirmed on disk, not caused by this change. Entry-path resolution independently verified for all 45 packages (probe-entry-paths.ts, 0 missing). Formatting: my code is prettier-clean under `.prettierrc.json`; the file has ~8 hunks of PRE-EXISTING prettier drift that I deliberately did NOT reformat (would produce a huge diff on a hot shared file).

=== NEW FINDINGS SURFACED (this is the point of the fix — none of these are fixed here; all are outside this ticket's script.ts-only ownership) ===

A. taxonomy/dirs — 4 REAL violations in already-migrated, already-closed plugins (warn/medium), artifact dirs containing a word that is not in `artifactChildDirs`:
   - `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏛️architect/🗿️artifacts/🏛️program/🧱️kernel`
   - `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏛️architect/🗿️artifacts/🏛️program/🗄️registers`
   - `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏭️process/🗿️artifacts/🧊️process3d/📚️examples`  ← Shape V2 says data dirs live at the OWNER root, not inside an artifact
   - `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/🗿️artifacts/📐️cad/🎬️interaction-spec`
   Needs a forward-fix agent per plugin, or a deliberate vocabulary extension in `🔣️taxonomy.json` with a ticket citation.

B. taxonomy/lib-shape — 4 entry files far past the 150-line wiring budget (the anti-inlining tripwire, live for the first time):
   - `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔱️trinity/🔨️modules/🔌️jack/🧠️lsp/📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs` ~529 lines (medium — inside a plugin owner)
   - `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust/🎯️targets/⌨️tui/📦️lib.rs` ~2217 lines (low)
   - `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust/🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/📦️lib.rs` ~10707 lines (low)
   - `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/📺️renderer/🧑️‍🎨️engine/📦️packages/🦀️rust/🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/📦️lib.rs` ~818 lines (low)
   The three framework ones are the plan's own known "moves as-is, splitting is a separately-ticketed follow-up" godfiles — expected, now measured. Trinity's LSP is a genuinely new one.

C. app-plugin/stray-cargo-artifact — 5 git-TRACKED nested `Cargo.lock` files (M1 finding #5, now machine-enforced):
   - HIGH: `✏️s/🔌️plugins/✒️writer/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.lock`, `✏️s/🔌️plugins/💡️reasoning/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.lock`
   - LOW (new surface): `✏️s/🔨️modules/💭️mindmap/…`, `✏️s/🔨️modules/◻2d/…`, `🌎️hub/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.lock`
   Also tracked but INVISIBLE to the rule: `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🌊️flow/🧩️extensions/🏗️bim/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.lock` — because that package still has no `role` marker (M1 finding #2, still open). Confirms that finding is still live.

D. app-plugin/app-coupling — 15 cross-plugin path dependencies, newly visible because plugin package manifests are now read:
   - Expected/by-design: 🎪️demonstrator → procedural/cad/puzzle/sourcing/process/gis (6).
   - Worth a look: ✒️writer → trinity; 💠️lowpoly → cad_plugin; 📕️norm → fem's OLD `🫀️core` legacy crate (the known un-applied 3-line repoint from norm's registrar handoff).
   - NEW surface (low): `✏️s/🔨️modules/📜️imperative` (s-module) → 5 of 📜️imperative-plugin's extension crates; and `🧰️framework/…/📺️renderer/🧑️‍🎨️engine` (framework) → 🧩️puzzle — i.e. a FRAMEWORK package depending on a plugin, the known board-2d/wgpu-renderer coupling from puzzle's migration.

E. CLEAN (genuinely good news, verified not vacuous): `taxonomy/component-file` = 0 across all 32 plugins — every taxonomy leaf really is named `🦀️component.rs`. `taxonomy/barrel-shape` = 0 (correctly still vacuous, no area has graduated to `clean`).

F. Process note, not actioned: `policyAppCouplingBreaches` emits duplicate breach ids when a manifest lists the same path dep in both `[dependencies]` and `[dev-dependencies]` (seen on the s-module imperative crate before it was deleted mid-run). Pre-existing rule behaviour, harmless, never observable before this ticket made the rule fire.

G. Process note: the shared repo-lib `📦️index.ts`'s `runPolicyScript` prints 6 `[DEBUG]` lines on every policy run and resolves the ROOT script's entity id to `compose` (breach cache lands at `.🦑️repo/⚡️cache/breaches/compose.json`). Both look like leftovers/bugs in someone else's file — not touched.

CONSTRAINTS RESPECTED: no plugin directory, root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, package.json, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, registry script/generated output or launch.json touched; no git-modifying commands run; all scratch files kept inside this ticket folder.
